title: Unique Crisp Norwegian Black Bean Bowl
description: A low-carb, fermented, and crisp Norwegian dish featuring black beans, served in a bamboo tray, perfect for a romantic dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the fermented black beans, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Spread the black bean mixture onto a bamboo tray lined with parchment paper.
Top the black bean mixture with crispy onions, crumbly feta cheese, and chopped fresh parsley.
Drizzle the lemon juice over the top of the black bean mixture.
Bake the black bean mixture in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Remove the bamboo tray from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Serve the Unique Crisp Norwegian Black Bean Bowl hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
